summary: Raised to S1 by the 22-28 re-grade of codex S1 findings against the code at the audit base. The V3 minimum-liquidity gate treats a quote that did not revert as proof the pool is deep enough; a thin V3 pool does not make the quote revert, so the gate passes any pool with some liquidity. The configured minimum (0.5 ETH on Ethereum, 1 BNB on BSC, 0.1 on Base and Arbitrum) is therefore not enforced on V3, and the bot can buy a pool thinner than the operator asked for; the other gates measure tax and honeypots, not depth.
